title: Agent Insights: what it uses
lede: One arrow for each component this feature lists. The steps reuse the feature's own "how it works" text; nothing here is a new claim. Internal and confidential: this text comes from an internal Ping deck and has not been tested on our tenant.

steps.title: Guard view
steps.what: Guard shows every inspection result: the category that fired, the rule that corroborated it, the direction, the decision taken and the agent and person behind it.
steps.why: Enforcement is only half of an investigation: decisions and detections scatter across one record set per surface, so "what happened" takes days to answer and incidents stay open.

steps.title: Compliance view
steps.what: A compliance view cross-references each finding to the OWASP taxonomies alongside MITRE ATLAS and NIST AI RMF, so evidence leaves in the shape an assessor asked for.

steps.title: Sealed prompt content
steps.what: Content is sealed to your key and shown as sealed until you load the private half, while the searchable detail around it (who ran it, which agent, which application, what was detected, what was decided) stays in the clear so you can find the one record you need before decrypting it.
